mission: Reach the first KES 1,000,000 in confirmed business revenue through real customer value.
principles: Prefer high-value B2B implementations over many tiny transactions.
Use evidence before scaling a vertical or offer.
No fabricated leads, identities, payments, testimonials or results.
Every paid project should create reusable proof and a repeatable product.

team.mission: Choose the highest-value evidence-backed commercial path.
Find real business problems with public evidence and buying signals.
Validate market, vertical, pain, competitor and timing evidence.
Turn a verified problem into a concrete AI implementation offer and price.
Identify legitimate public business contacts; never guess contact details.
Personalize concise outreach, qualify interest and move leads to a demo/proposal.
Follow up only when permitted and suppress STOP/negative responses.
Assemble the smallest working AI system that can demonstrate business value.
Generate vertical-specific demos and proof-of-value assets.
Onboard, measure outcomes, retain and identify legitimate expansion opportunities.
Track quotes, confirmed payments, revenue, AI cost and gross margin.
Protect privacy, permissions, opt-outs, provider rules and auditability.
Learn from funnel outcomes and reallocate effort toward measured conversion.

today_priority: Package one irresistible, demonstrable offer per tested vertical.
Run compliant personalized outreach where provider credentials permit it.
Convert positive replies into demos/proposals and confirmed deposits.
